ModMetaData.name: Master Bill List
ModMetaData.author: Ken Perkins
ModMetaData.description:
Workbenches of the same type can share ONE bill list per map.
Toggle "Use shared bills" on a bench, then edit its bills through the normal Bills tab — every other opted-in bench of that type reflects the change live and works the same bills. No more re-creating the same recipe on every butcher table, stove, smithy, or machining bench.
Features: - Per-type, per-map shared bill lists (butcher tables share one list, stonecutters another, etc.). - One-click opt-in toggle on each bench; works with multi-select. - Non-destructive: opting out restores the bench's own original bills. - "Do X times" / "Do until you have X" count once across all shared benches (single shared counter). - Safe save/load; handles deconstructing benches and unfinished-thing recipes (sculptures, components). - Automatically covers modded workbenches.
Requires Harmony. Safe to add to an existing save; benches start un-shared until you toggle them.
